summary: Ran full vesper-native JVM/build regression and external preview contract smoke. Fixed obsolete test assumptions (home first row and login payload expectation), then re-ran successfully. Verified download endpoint headers, APK version metadata, and signer digest comparison.

integration_issues.issue: Built debug APK verifies only v2 signature; apksigner reports v1=false. If parity gate requires both v1+v2, this currently fails.

integration_issues.flow: APK zipalign/aapt verification in this container
integration_issues.issue: Host build-tools binaries (aapt/zipalign) are incompatible in this environment (Exec format error), so those two checks could not be executed with native binaries.

action_items: If release gate requires dual signing, enable/verify v1 signature in addition to v2 for produced artifact.

Add dedicated regression tests for StreamRepository sorting/header sanitization/URL rejection and for BrowseRepository networks|collections slug + genres|anime parse/error paths (these requested areas are not currently covered by dedicated unit tests).
Re-run zipalign/aapt checks in an environment with compatible Android build-tools binaries (or provide ARM64-compatible toolchain).
critical_code_review_comments: Obsolete test assumptions were the immediate blockers: home first-row tag changed (Networks/Studios first), and auth payload no longer includes client_id in native AuthRepository.
Read-only cloud contract remains enforced in tested code path (ProfileCloudRepository pull-only GET /api/vesper/sync/pull).
No runtime WebView references found in vesper-native main sources (grep check clean).
MOCKED fixtures are used in JVM tests; external backend smoke used real preview endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 98.2% pass in native JVM suite (55 pass / 56 total, 1 skip) + assembleDebug pass

context_for_next_testing_agent: Current baseline after fixes: :app:testDebugUnitTest and :app:assembleDebug PASS. External preview contract test file PASS with testuser/testpass123 injected via env vars. Download endpoint returns content-disposition filename vesper-native-v0.2.0.apk and cache-control no-store. BuildConfig/apkanalyzer confirm versionCode=5, versionName=0.2.0-native-dev, API_BASE_URL=https://onnowtv.duckdns.org.
rca of the issue: Root cause of native suite failure was outdated test assumptions, not runtime app crash: (1) MainActivity test hardcoded old first shelf tag 'shelf-list-a1-movie-year' despite new first rows (Networks/Studios), causing timeout; (2) AuthRepository test still required client_id while implementation now posts username/password only. After updating tests to dynamic row discovery and current auth payload contract, JVM/build pipeline returned green.
